description: This PHP source file defines the 'FunctionalTestingPluginSubscriber' class, which subscribes to controller events in the Symfony framework, specifically handling logic related to functional testing routes and enforcing production mode restrictions.

classes.name: FunctionalTestingPluginSubscriber
classes.description: A Symfony event subscriber that intercepts controller events to restrict access to functional testing routes when the application is in production mode.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array of events this class subscribes to, specifically the Kernel's controller event, with a high priority to handle the event early.

methods.name: onControllerEvent
methods.description: Event handler that checks if the incoming request targets a functional testing path or controller, and if in production mode, throws a ForbiddenException to prevent access.

methods.name: getControllerInstance
methods.description: Helper method to retrieve the controller instance from the event.
